name: Folder Mute
description: Hold a server folder for a third option, Mute folder: mute every server in it for 15 minutes, 1, 3, 8 or 24 hours, or until you turn it back on, like muting a server. Unmute folder brings them back. Works in the server list and in Server Drawer+.
author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")
